faq.q: Can I subdivide an acreage in Abbotsford?
faq.a: It depends on the zoning, whether the land is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, servicing and the minimum lot size, and it needs municipal approval. Ask the municipality before you buy with a subdivision in mind.

faq.q: Do acreages in Abbotsford have wells and septic?
faq.a: Many do. Ask for the well flow test and water quality results, and the septic filing and inspection records, before you remove conditions.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Abbotsford?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
